_: AUTHORED. The course names a term one way and this pack's glossary heads it another. Case and curly apostrophes are folded automatically (checklist.mjs normTerm) — everything here is a REAL difference somebody has looked at and confirmed. Without it a naive equality match reports 8 of the 64 published terms as uncovered, which is a fake-confident gap of exactly the kind self-explaining-ui-policy forbids: the entries all exist, under a merged or differently-spelled heading. G-CHK5 fails the build if any published term still resolves to nothing, and it also fails if an alias here stops being needed — an unused indirection is the shape of the dead ALIAS that once deleted ten of her questions.
